title: Audit every upstream public API
acceptance: Review all 302 inventory entries plus aliases and dynamic exports. Record implemented, intentionally different, unsupported or pending status with evidence.

title: Complete task cancellation and abrupt-kill semantic mapping
acceptance: Document cancellation-message policy and why abrupt Python kill has no direct safe C# equivalent; add conformance tests and link individual task API gaps.

title: Support mutable simulation task names
acceptance: Add simulator-thread-checked SetName for typed and untyped jobs; test observable names and invalid values; update TASK_API_MAP.md.

title: Add task completion waits usable with triggers
acceptance: Define completion-only versus result/failure propagation semantics; support mixed task/trigger waits with deterministic cleanup and cancellation tests.

title: Define public task-local and introspection APIs
acceptance: Decide task-local storage and .NET stack/introspection equivalents; document intentional Python differences and test chosen APIs.

title: Expand scheduler cancellation and teardown stress
acceptance: Extend simultaneous failure/reentrancy/leak scenarios beyond existing 100-race runs; retain failing seeds and verify native callback cleanup.

title: Expand timing and force/deposit conformance
acceptance: Add force/deposit ordering, same-time ties and VHDL timing cases with reference traces; retain existing delta and resolution tests.

title: Broaden VHDL type and construct coverage
acceptance: Add missing VHDL constructs and backend-specific test matrix; distinguish unsupported handles from verified behavior.

title: Validate mixed-language simulation and traversal
acceptance: Exercise VHDL/Verilog boundaries and global discovery with multiple adapters; establish supported configurations and ordering.

title: Infer named packed-struct fields from HDL metadata
acceptance: Recover field names widths order and offsets from authoritative elaborated metadata; handle nested fields; validate against independent HDL selections.

title: Infer multidimensional packed layouts beyond Verilator
acceptance: Implement backend metadata providers where information exists; retain explicit unavailable results for flattened declarations.

title: Implement backend driver/load connectivity discovery
acceptance: Add missing adapter support and verify known driver/load fixtures; never interpret an unavailable iterator as no connections.

title: Expand package and structure discovery matrix
acceptance: Test package members structures and arrays on each backend; document kind differences and completeness limits.

title: Support embedded NUL in dynamic HDL strings
acceptance: Implement length-aware native access where supported; test embedded NUL and bytes without silent truncation.

title: Make simulator capabilities comprehensive
acceptance: Replace scattered product assumptions with documented capabilities and tested evidence; reject unsupported operations explicitly.

title: Investigate intermittent native shutdown diagnostic
acceptance: Run debugger/fault-injection teardown investigation for historical fatal library error lookup self; identify root cause or preserve unresolved status with evidence.

title: Transfer packed values directly inside native adapters
acceptance: Avoid remaining GPI binary-string conversion; preserve value X/Z planes and validate width and allocation boundaries.

title: Benchmark representative CPU DSP and AXI designs
acceptance: Measure end-to-end workloads against pinned cocotb with warmup repeated processes allocation/GC and reproducible inputs.

title: Add native simulator clock option
acceptance: Implement native clock lifecycle cancellation and timing tests; compare performance and semantics with adjustable managed clock.

title: Add Roslyn incremental binding generator
acceptance: Generate typed bindings incrementally with diagnostics deterministic output and compile-positive/negative tests.

title: Annotate HDL direction and interface roles
acceptance: Expose authoritative input/output/inout metadata and validate typed interface roles without guessing from names.

title: Distribute native GPI dependencies reproducibly
acceptance: Package supported native dependencies with license provenance and clean-machine installation tests.

title: Publish versioned NuGet releases
acceptance: Define release/version policy and CI packing; validate clean consumers before public publication. Publication is a separate release action.

title: Support Windows native hosting and simulators
acceptance: Implement Windows host/loader and supported architecture packaging; execute native integration tests on Windows.

title: Support macOS native hosting and simulators
acceptance: Implement macOS host/loader and architecture packaging; execute native integration tests on macOS.

title: Validate commercial simulator adapters
acceptance: Run licensed Questa Xcelium VCS and Riviera fixtures where available; record versions capabilities and failures. Requires installations/licenses.

title: Document and validate debugger attachment
acceptance: Provide runnable managed/native debugger instructions and prove breakpoint/exception handling in a simulator process.

title: Add structured simulation logging and source mapping
acceptance: Include simulation time test/task identities exception stack/source locations and machine-readable output with bounded overhead.

title: Add coverage reporting integration
acceptance: Define functional/code coverage scope; implement export and verify coverage results with known fixtures.

title: Add waveform controls and artifacts
acceptance: Expose supported waveform enable/path controls and link generated artifacts to test results; verify backend limitations.

title: Add test fixtures and cleanup lifecycle
acceptance: Implement setup/teardown scopes with cancellation and failure aggregation; guarantee cleanup on failed and timed-out tests.

title: Add regression stages
acceptance: Define stable stage ordering and failure policies; test parameterized cases and stage selection.

title: Expand regression selection and reporting
acceptance: Add explicit selection/discovery controls and richer reports while retaining stable seeds and machine-readable failures.

title: Assess Native AOT and reflection trimming
acceptance: Prototype hosting and test discovery under trimming/AOT; document blockers and verify process lifecycle before support claims.

title: Define Python test reuse boundary
acceptance: Choose interoperability scope and prove a minimal bridge or document deliberate non-support; C# is not Python source compatible.

title: Implement deterministic external-thread wakeups
acceptance: Bridge external/background work to simulator-thread scheduling with cancellation timeout and shutdown tests.

title: Map Python-only convenience APIs
acceptance: Decide equivalents or documented exclusions for IPython assertion rewriting decorators/previews object protocols and environment options.

title: Build protocol-driver ecosystem separately from core
acceptance: Prioritize reusable AXI/UART/other drivers with versioned packages and independent hardware-backed test fixtures.

title: Establish repository structure contribution docs and CI
acceptance: Add solution docs index contributor guide issue templates and unit/build CI; retain pinned upstream provenance and historical evidence.

title: Expand lock semaphore queue fairness stress
acceptance: Test contention cancellation and fairness guarantees for synchronization primitives; document guarantees and limits.

title: Adopt xUnit for managed tests and external simulator orchestration
acceptance: Migrate the standalone managed assertion program incrementally to named xUnit facts/theories; preserve all 1,916 assertion checks and add per-case discovery/results in CI. Pin compatible packages and analyzers. Keep simulator-thread tests under SimTest; isolate external simulator processes and artifact directories, serializing existing shared build paths. Prove an injected managed failure is individually reported while independent tests continue. Keep native ABI and compiler-negative tests.

title: Add targeted NSubstitute tests for managed lifecycle boundaries
acceptance: During fixture cleanup work (#31), extract only a justified managed cleanup/observer boundary or use existing delegates. Test cleanup exactly once, reverse order, all callbacks attempted, cancellation, and aggregation with the original test failure. Use NSubstitute plus analyzers for call contracts, real objects for value behavior. Retain native fault injection and four-backend integration evidence; do not proxy static P/Invoke or substitute simulator scheduling.

title: Pilot Testcontainers for reproducible simulator integration
acceptance: Build and pin a Linux Icarus image with the required .NET runtime and pinned cocotb native adapters; launch real simulator tests through Testcontainers from an external test process. Assert exit code AND nonempty expected result set with no failed cases. Capture logs/results/waveforms before disposal; test timeout/nonzero/missing-result paths. Isolate workspaces, document Docker prerequisites and explicit unavailable status, then expand to Verilator/GHDL/NVC after a green Docker-enabled CI run. Compare packaging and startup cost against the existing process runner. No claim of Windows/macOS coverage from Linux containers.

title: Compare and implement owned gather/select semantics from cocotb 2.1
acceptance: Version-specific contract matrix, owned/borrowed inputs, typed results, cancellation and cleanup guarantees, released Python oracle and native-platform evidence.

title: Extend debugger validation to Windows, macOS and simultaneous native/managed sessions
acceptance: Pin suitable tools; validate managed breakpoint/local/exception/resume/exit and native startup/callback/finish on Windows x64 and macOS ARM64; prove simultaneous debugger ownership or document a validated alternative; retain evidence and explicit blockers.
